name: Addis Ababa
tagline: Highland capital of coffee, Lucy and injera
summary: Addis Ababa is Ethiopia's high-altitude capital and the seat of the African Union. Meet Lucy, the 3.2-million-year-old hominid, at the National Museum, explore the vast Merkato market, join a coffee ceremony, take in a traditional dance show and fly on to Lalibela's rock-hewn churches.
seasonNote: October to February is dry and sunny; June to September is the rainy season.
arrival: Bole International, Ethiopian Airlines' hub, is 20 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Ride-hailing apps (Ride, Feres) and the light rail.
cashTip: Carry birr in small notes; cards work in big hotels only. Exchange at banks.
foodTip: Injera with doro wat and a coffee ceremony.
